title: Voice in the workspace: continuous listening that talks to teammates by name
description:
First integration slice of docs/VOICE.md into the hey.chattic.us workspace (build order steps 2-4). On-device Moonshine Tiny; only addressed lines leave the tab, as ordinary POST /messages turns.

Feature: Talk to teammates by voice in the workspace
  Scenario: A line addressed to a teammate becomes a message to that teammate
    Given I am in the workspace with teammates Ada and Grace
    And voice listening is on
    When I say "Ada, open a pull request for the voice spike"
    Then a message "open a pull request for the voice spike" is posted to Ada
  Scenario: Speech that is not addressed to a teammate never leaves the browser
    When I say "I think we should get lunch"
    Then no message is posted
  Scenario: Switching teammates by voice makes no cloud call
    When I say "switch to Grace"
    Then Grace is the selected teammate
  Scenario: Saying stop listening turns the microphone off
  Scenario: Voice is unavailable when the page cannot be cross-origin isolated

Not included: spoken replies (TTS), HITL/approval answers, turn cancel, the Moonshine fork.
